sql: SELECT CASE labels.label WHEN '+' THEN 'carcinogenic' WHEN '-' THEN 'non-carcinogenic' END AS label_type FROM (SELECT '+' AS label UNION ALL SELECT '-') AS labels WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM molecule AS m JOIN atom AS a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE a.element = 'sn' AND m.label = labels.label)
